india5.title: Bengaluru’s new development minister is everywhere. Is Krishna Byre Gowda’s entry too late to save the city?
india5.description: Gowda has adopted an aggressive, hands-on approach, signalling a shift towards stricter accountability in city governance.

india5.title: Swahili Queen’s letters among documents surveyed at Goa archives, India’s oldest
india5.description: Goa archives director Balaji Shenvy said they launched their survey around three months ago and have since surveyed over 31,000 manuscripts and documents

india5.title: Slapped, abducted, killed: How a bike grazing a car took a violent turn for Ghaziabad teen
india5.description: Police have arrested one of the accused, while efforts are underway to trace the second suspect.

india5.title: Four killed as 2 lorries catch fire after crash on NH-16 in Andhra Pradesh: Cops
india5.description: Four people, including two drivers and two cleaners, were charred to death after two lorries collided head-on and caught fire on NH-16 in Andhra Pradesh’s Guntur district.

india5.title: Big win for Raghav Chadha as Delhi HC directs takedown of defamatory content
india5.description: The order came after the Rajya Sabha MP filed a petition seeking protection against the circulation of defamatory and AI-manipulated content against him online.

india5.title: Sachin Ahir wins key Maharashtra poll day after quitting Uddhav Sena for Shinde-led camp
india5.description: Sachin Ahir was elected to the post unanimously after Mahavikas Aghadi (MVA) candidate JM Abhyankar withdrew his nomination.

india5.title: Arrest hours before retirement: Inside IAS officer ‘deep conspiracy’ in  ₹504 crore Haryana IDFC Bank fraud case
india5.description: Suspended IAS officer Pardeep Kumar arrested by CBI for alleged ₹504 crore embezzlement from Haryana government accounts, causing ₹169 crore loss.

india5.title: Maharashtra govt to set up expert panel for AI smart glasses SOPs, says minister
india5.description: The announcement was made by Kadam in the state assembly on Tuesday in response to concerns raised by legislators

india5.title: ‘Lost 2 kg, BP low’: Dipke flags concerns over Sonam Wangchuk's health amid hunger strike, activist says he is ‘fine’
india5.description: Wangchuk began the hunger strike on June 28 last week seeking the resignation of union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the NEET-UG paper leak deaths.

india5.title: ‘He is a Muslim. That's all there is to it’: How a 75-year-old ruling undid Tamil Nadu order on BCM quota
india5.description: Quashing a 2024 state government order, the Madras HC held that conversion to Islam doesn't automatically confer backward class Muslim status.

india5.title: ‘Contradicts existing state laws’: Tamil Nadu moves SC against Madras HC's ban on cow slaughter
india5.description: The High Court ordered a blanket ban on the slaughter of cows and calves anywhere in the state on May 27.

india5.title: IndiGo introduces ‘Lite’ fare for economy flyers travelling with only cabin bag
india5.description: The airline said that this new fare will be available for booking exclusively on IndiGo’s direct channels including the website, mobile application and contact centre

india5.title: Commercial LPG, petrol, diesel, jet fuel: Big price cuts in India as war eases. Full list
india5.description: From petrol and diesel price cuts by Nayara Energy to reduction in rates of commercial LPG cylinder, several oil prices were reduced in India on Wednesday.

india5.title: Want cheaper IndiGo ticket for same distance? Lite Fare could help you out. Key features explained
india5.description: The new fare will be available for booking from July 1, through IndiGo's direct booking channels, while travel under this category will begin from July 15.

india5.title: 'Some get too much': Sanjay Raut hints Uddhav loyalists are hurt amid mass exits, calls for introspection
india5.description: Sanjay Raut's remarks came days after six MPs exited the UBT Sena and joined the rival Sena led by Maharashtra deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde.

india5.title: 4-year-old boy who fell into 220-foot-deep borewell in Ambala dies after 21-hour rescue operation
india5.description: The boy, was brought out of the borewell at around 3:45 am and was immediately rushed by ambulance to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

india5.title: Pune case: Chetan taken to Lohagad for 'gait analysis'; lawyer claims ‘no specific role’
india5.description: Both Siya Goyal and Chetan Chaudhary are accused of killing Pune-based realtor Ketan Agarwal by allegedly pushing him off a cliff at the Lohagad Fort.

india6.title: T.N. Minister Nirmalkumar accuses DMK’s Senthilbalaji of attempting to lure TVK MLAs
india6.description: Mr. Nirmalkumar claimed several TVK MLAs were approached by the DMK telling it intended to move a no-confidence motion against the Speaker in the next Assembly session and asked them to vote in support of it. One of the TVK MLAs lodged a complaint, based on which three persons were arrested.

india6.title: Andhra Pradesh Information Commission dismisses 160 RTI cases, raps appellant over misuse
india6.description: The Commission said Naidu Nagarjuna Reddy had filed thousands of applications and over 400 second appeals, using the RTI Act as a litigation tool rather than for transparency

india6.title: Karnataka High Court declines to quash UAPA case against associates of US-based Christian missionary organisation The Timothy Initiative
india6.description: One of the gravest threats to national security in the present times is, the clandestine funding of extremism, said Court

india6.title: Kerala will not allow communalisation of education, no compromise on university autonomy: Roji M. John
india6.description: Minister says Higher Education department will undertake a comprehensive review of the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme. Necessary reforms will be introduced to address the practical difficulties experienced by students and colleges

india6.title: Kerala takes another step towards becoming ‘Keralam,’ Assembly unanimously approves President’s reference
india6.description: House considers Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, which was referred by the President to seek its opinion. The legislators unanimously endorse all queries raised by the President on the Bill’s 10 clauses

india6.title: MES demands SIR forms in Marathi, activist asks if Maharashtra is doing the same for Kannada-speaking people
india6.description: During a door-to-door visit of SIR staff in Bandur Galli in Belagavi on July 1, MES leader and former member of the Belagavi city corporation Sunil Balekundri refused to accept the enumeration forms in Kannada

india6.title: Make learning and innovation lifelong pursuits, President Murmu tells Andhra graduates
india6.description: At the first convocation of the Central University of Andhra Pradesh, the President said a degree should mark the beginning, not the end, of the pursuit of knowledge

india6.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLC Sachin Ahir elected Maharashtra Legislative Council’s deputy Chairman as Mahayuti candidate
india6.description: Opposition MVA fielded Jagannath Abhyankar of the Shiv Sena (UBT) for the post; however, on the appeal of Legislative Affairs Minister Chandrakant Patil, Shiv Sena (UBT) legislator Anil Parab said the Opposition was withdrawing Mr. Abhyankar’s candidature

india6.title: Monsoon tracker LIVE: Helicopter services suspended amid adverse weather conditions in Kedarnath Dham Yatra
india6.description: District Magistrate of Rudraprayag, Vishal Mishra, said that all helicopter operations for the pilgrimage have been halted until further notice

india6.title: Implementation of VB-G RAM-G without opposition amounts to failure in protecting Tamil Nadu’s financial well-being: Thangam Thennarasu
india6.description: Under VB-G RAM-G scheme, which comes into force with effect from July 1, the State’s contribution has been increased to 40%. The Centre reducing its contribution for the Centrally-sponsored programmes will lead to fiscal strain on Tamil Nadu, he said.

india6.title: Maharashtra minister privately admitted he didn't know TET exam papers printed in Agra, says BJP MLA
india6.description: The State School Education Minister’s admission exposed serious lapses in the functioning of the School Education Department, the former Minister Sudhir Mungantiwar said and underscored the need for a comprehensive review of all State-level examinations

india6.title: CPI(M), CPI leaders meet Tamil Nadu CM Vijay, press various demands
india6.description: The TVK-led Tamil Nadu government, before tabling a resolution in the Assembly on Mekedatu issue, should have called an all-party meeting to take the issue forward, said CPI(M) leader P. Shanmugam

india6.title: Kerala Assembly passes resolution urging Centre to withdraw amendments to FCRA rules
india6.description: Resolution, moved by Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, terms the amendments ‘a breach of Constitutional provisions and federal principles’

india6.title: Why managing fiscal is a tightrope for State governments
india6.description: Most State government expenditure is on social sectors, such as health and education, and economic sectors, such as agriculture and irrigation. In Kerala, such spending has driven social progress since the 1960s. The gap between expenditure and receipts is usually financed through market borrowings.

india6.title: Foreign medical graduates allowed to take up CRMI in 36 non-teaching hospitals in Tamil Nadu
india6.description: This has fulfilled a long-pending demand of hundreds of FMGs, who had passed the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination and were waiting for the mandatory CRMI

india6.title: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as new Vice-Chief of the Air Staff
india6.description: Prior to the ceremony, the air officer visited the National War Memorial and laid a wreath to pay homage to the fallen heroes of the armed forces

india6.title: Madras High Court Registrar General Alli retires pending recommendation to elevate her as judge
india6.description: Principal District Judge Deepthi Arivunithi appointed as the new Registrar General of the High Court

india6.title: Scientists use budget tech to probe long-standing physics mystery
india6.description: The study was driven by a long-standing debate over whether ruthenium dioxide possesses a rare, unconventional type of magnetism called altermagnetism

india6.title: Former staff of T.N. Civil Supplies Corporation complain to CM Vijay over ‘low’ off-take of wheat under PDS
india6.description: The association suggested to Mr. Vijay that the State government seek higher allotment of wheat from the Centre in lieu of rice.

india6.title: Ketan Agarwal murder: Fiancée kept victim’s phone with her for some time
india6.description: According to a police official, the investigation has shown that Agarwal’s mobile phone came into Goyal’s possession after he was allegedly pushed off the cliff at the historical site

india6.title: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve core closed till September 30 for tiger breeding season
india6.description: The core of the Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve is shut to tourists and pilgrims until September 30; its tiger count has risen from 47 in 2018 to 76 in 2024

india6.title: Telangana’s OGH doctors perform 36-hour surgery to transplant five organs on one patient
india6.description: All organs for the transplant were donated by a woman who was declared brain dead. The multi-visceral transplant is claimed as India’s first.

india6.title: FM Sitharaman embarks on 4-day official visit to France to bolster economic ties
india6.description: India and France will discuss potential areas for greater bilateral cooperation in various sectors, and further enhance the economic relations between India and France, an official statement said

india6.title: First tranche of funds under Annapurna Yojana transferred to 1.1 crore women beneficiaries: Bengal CM
india6.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that it is not possible to transfer taxpayers' money from government coffers to non-Indians, while justifying the rejection of 26 lakh Annapurna Yojana applications

india6.title: Annapurna Yojana: Women beneficiaries to receive ₹3,000 in West Bengal’s new cash assistance scheme
india6.description: Under the Annapura Yojana scheme, women will receive ₹3,000 per month. The existing Lakshmir Bhandar scheme will continue until the new programme is fully implemented

india6.title: Rain disrupts Mumbai commuter services; waterlogging reported
india6.description: The Central Railway and Western Railway officials issued statements regarding the rescheduling of some services. Passengers waited at stations for longer durations

india6.title: Kerala Assembly: Minister says govt to prioritise battery energy storage systems to tackle power crisis
india6.description: Five of six BESS projects on the anvil are expected to be completed by 2026-end and these will provide 1,500 MW in storage capability, Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph tells House

india6.title: Sahitya Akademi award-winning poet Puviyarasu laid to rest with State honours in Coimbatore
india6.description: Puviyarasu, a two-time Sahitya Akademi Award recipient and a founding member of the Vanampadi poetry movement, died on June 30, 2026

india6.title: U.P. SIT probing Ram temple donation matter granted 15-day extension
india6.description: The tenure of the Special Investigation Team (SIT) has been extended to probe the matter deeply and widen the scope of the probe

india6.title: Private bus catches fire at Vadalur, passengers escape unhurt
india6.description: The bus broke down when it reached Vadalur following which the bus crew evacuated the passengers. Within a few minutes, a fire broke out in the vehicle’s battery.

india7.title: Commercial LPG cylinder price cut by ₹183.50; Nayara reduces fuel prices
india7.description: Commercial LPG cylinder prices fell by ₹183.50 from July 1, while domestic prices and state-owned fuel prices remained unchanged; Nayara Energy cut petrol by ₹5 and diesel by ₹3 per litre.

india7.title: WhatsApp introduces usernames: Here's how to reserve yours & chat without sharing phone number
india7.description: WhatsApp is rolling out usernames allowing users to connect privately without sharing phone numbers, with early reservations now open.

india7.title: MSC Shipping to acquire 49% stake in Adani Vizhinjam Port
india7.description: MSC Group's TiL will acquire a 49% stake in Adani Vizhinjam Port Private Limited for approximately ₹132.28 billion, marking a significant foreign investment to enhance transshipment capabilities.

india7.title: HiLITE Group’s ₹300-crore YOO Hub Trivandrum workspace opens at Technopark Phase III
india7.description: HiLITE Group's ₹300-crore YOO Hub Trivandrum, India's first YOO-branded IT Park, opened, aiming to create 5,000 jobs with global design and workspace expertise.

india7.title: Assam reels under devastating floods; over 45,000 hit
india7.description: Assam floods affect over 45,000 people, with Dhemaji hit hardest. The Union Home Minister pledged support, while ministers oversee relief, rescue, and anti-erosion efforts amid damaged infrastructure and submerged villages.

india7.title: World asteroid day: How can humans avoid tragic fate of dinosaurs
india7.description: World Asteroid Day commemorates the 1908 Tunguska impact. It raises awareness of space threats, advocating for investment in planetary defence to mitigate risks from asteroids.

india7.title: The Paradox of Modern Marketing: We know more about consumers than ever, yet understand them less than ever
india7.description: Marketers possess vast data but lack understanding, mistaking observation for comprehension. Companies like Kodak and Netflix failed by misinterpreting consumer behaviour, not lacking information. Future success hinges on sensing change, not just measuring it.

india7.title: Citizen Watches India hosts exclusive collectors, enthusiasts evening in New Delhi
india7.description: Citizen Watches India and WatchTime India held an exclusive Collectors & Enthusiasts Evening in New Delhi, showcasing Citizen and Bulova timepieces and fostering community engagement.

india7.title: Veteran journalist Rajagopal says his passport wasn't renewed over SIR exclusion
india7.description: Former editor R Rajagopal alleges his passport renewal was stalled after his name was removed from electoral rolls during a Special Intensive Revision, impacting his rights.

india7.title: A rare win-win-win for NRIs, banks and India
india7.description: India's Reserve Bank has demonstrated innovation and agility in managing economic challenges, particularly through its latest initiatives on FCNR deposits and external commercial borrowings, attracting significant inflows.

japan1.title: モバイルSuica トラブルから夕方に復旧 サーバー不具合が原因
japan1.description: 交通機関の運賃の支払いなどを行うモバイルSuicaで1日朝からアプリでのチャージができないなどのトラブルがありましたが、JR東日本は1日夕方、復旧したと発表しました。外部のシステムとつながるサーバーに不具合が発生したことが原因だということです。

japan1.title: 日銀短観発表 大企業の製造業の指数改善 ものづくりの現場は
japan1.description: 日銀が7月1日に発表した、短観＝企業短期経済観測調査で、大企業の製造業の景気判断を示す指数は前回の調査を5ポイント上回り、5期連続の改善となりました。こうした中で、新規の設備投資を進めるメーカーがある一方、イラン情勢の影響による石油製品の入荷の遅れや、価格の高止まりへの懸念も根強く残っています。ものづくりの現場は…

japan1.title: 「路線価」全国平均 過去最大の上昇率 観光地で大幅上昇目立つ
japan1.description: 相続税などの基準となる土地の価格「路線価」が1日、公表され、全国の調査地点の平均は5年連続で上昇し、上昇率も2010年以降で最も大きくなりました。外国人観光客の増加を背景に観光地で大幅な上昇が目立っています。記事の後半では都道府県別の増減率も掲載しています。

japan1.title: 5月ガソリン補助 約2900億円支出 6月末の基金残高約3800億円に
japan1.description: ガソリンなどの価格を抑える政府の補助金について、ことし5月はおよそ2900億円が支出されました。経済産業省によりますと、補助に充てる基金の残高は6月末の時点でおよそ3800億円だとしています。

japan1.title: 株価 値上がり 半導体関連の銘柄中心に買い注文
japan1.description: 1日の東京株式市場、半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い注文が入って、日経平均株価は値上がりしました。

japan1.title: ガソリン価格 全国平均169.8円 政府補助金で170円水準続く
japan1.description: 国の委託を受けて調査している石油情報センターによりますと、レギュラーガソリンの小売価格は、6月29日時点の全国平均で1リットル当たり169.8円と前の週と同じ価格でした。政府の激変緩和措置による補助金で170円程度の水準が続いています。

japan1.title: 米大統領 資産報告書公開“主要収益は暗号資産関連 2300億円”
japan1.description: アメリカ政府は、トランプ大統領が申告した2025年の資産報告書を公開しました。アメリカのメディアは、主要な収益は暗号資産に関するもので、その金額は少なくとも14億ドル、日本円でおよそ2300億円に上ると伝えています。

japan1.title: 高校生の就職活動が事実上スタート “初任給30万円”企業も
japan1.description: 来年春に卒業する高校生の就職活動が、7月1日、事実上、スタートしました。企業の人手不足を背景に、高い求人倍率が見込まれ、売手市場となる見通しです。

japan1.title: 旅券手数料 きょうから最大7000円引き下げ “余裕持ち申請を”
japan1.description: パスポートの申請手数料が1日から最大で7000円引き下げられました。木原官房長官は申請の大幅な増加が予想され交付まで最大で1か月程度かかる可能性があるとして、余裕を持って申請するよう呼びかけました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 7月1日(水) 記録的株高 新規上場企業の戦略は
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: NYダウ平均株価が最高値更新 AI需要拡大や米景気への期待で
japan1.description: 6月30日のニューヨーク株式市場では半導体や大手ITといった銘柄に買い注文が広がり、ダウ平均株価は小幅に上昇して最高値を更新しました。

japan1.title: “出国税” きょうから引き上げ 1人当たり1000円が3000円に
japan1.description: 日本を出国する際に課される「国際観光旅客税」いわゆる出国税が、7月1日から引き上げられます。これまでは1人当たり1000円でしたが3000円となり、各地で課題となるオーバーツーリズムの対策などに充てられることになっています。

japan1.title: 円相場 一時1ドル＝162円80銭台まで円安進む
japan1.description: 1日の東京外国為替市場、円を売ってドルを買う動きが一段と進んで円相場は一時1ドル＝162円80銭台まで値下がりしました。

japan1.title: 「骨太の方針」の原案 強い経済実現向け国内投資拡大打ち出す
japan1.description: ことしの「骨太の方針」の原案がまとまり、「責任ある積極財政」の考え方のもと、強い経済の実現に向けて国内投資の拡大や供給力の強化を打ち出しています。また、民間投資を引き出すため「財政単年度主義」の弊害を是正し、財政運営の目標は債務残高の対GDP比を安定的に低下させることを中核に位置づけています。

japan1.title: 日銀 審議委員に佐藤綾野氏が就任 “データ重視で政策判断”
japan1.description: 日銀の金融政策の決定に関わる審議委員に、青山学院大学教授などを務めた佐藤綾野氏が30日就任し、金融政策についてはデータを重視しながら判断したいという考えを強調しました。

japan1.title: USJ 発売後も入場券の価格が変動する制度導入へ 9月入場分から
japan1.description: 大阪のテーマパーク「ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン」は、ことし9月の入場分から、需要に応じて発売後も入場券の価格が変動する制度を導入すると発表しました。

japan1.title: 記録的水準の円安 今後は？暮らしはどうなる？【詳しく】
japan1.description: 続く円安の傾向。30日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は1ドル＝162円台前半と、およそ39年半ぶりの円安ドル高水準になりました。今後の見通しは。暮らしへの影響は。専門家の分析や、仕入れコストの上昇に悩む現場など、円安に関するニュースをまとめてお伝えします。

japan1.title: 7月の食品値上げ2566品目 5年連続で1万品目超えの見通しも
japan1.description: 7月に値上げされる食品は2500品目余りに上ることが民間の調査会社のまとめで分かりました。調査した会社では、中東情勢の影響でコストが上昇した分を価格に転嫁する動きが続いていることから、企業による値上げの動きは秋ごろまで続くとみています。

japan1.title: 5月の原油輸入量 前年比38％減 代替調達で4月より減少幅は縮小
japan1.description: 資源エネルギー庁は、5月、日本に輸入された原油は729万キロリットルと去年より38％減ったと発表しました。ホルムズ海峡を通らないルートでの調達の拡大で、ことし4月に比べると減少の幅は縮小しました。

japan1.title: 6月の月例経済報告 「緩やかに回復」を維持
japan1.description: 政府は、6月の月例経済報告で景気の現状について「緩やかに回復しているが、中東情勢の影響を注視する必要がある」として、5月の基調判断を維持しました。個別の項目をみますと、「輸出」は東南アジア向けの半導体製造装置の出荷が増加していることなどを受けて「このところ持ち直しの動きがみられる」に1年4か月ぶりに上方修正したほか、「倒産件数」は去年まで続いていた増加傾向が足元で一服しているとして、「おおむね横ばいとなっている」に1年5か月ぶりに上方修正しました。

japan1.title: 日本航空 “空飛ぶクルマ”研究めぐり補助金を不正受給
japan1.description: 日本航空は「空飛ぶクルマ」やドローンの研究事業をめぐり、およそ5年にわたって労務費の水増しなどで国からの補助金、2億8000万円余りを不正に受け取っていたと発表しました。

japan1.title: “AIロボット 製造業などの分野で1000万台規模に” 政府新目標
japan1.description: 人手不足が深刻化するなか、経済産業省は2040年までに製造業や医療をはじめとする18の分野で、あわせて1000万台規模のAIを搭載したロボットを導入する目標を新たに掲げました。

japan1.title: 株価 一時1000円以上値上がり AIや半導体関連銘柄に買い注文
japan1.description: 6月30日の東京株式市場、このところ値下がりしていたAIや半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い戻しの動きが出て、日経平均株価は一時、1000円以上値上がりしました。

japan1.title: アフラック生命 約438万人分 個人情報漏えい 一部は口座情報も
japan1.description: がん保険を手がけるアフラック生命は、保険内容を確認する契約者専用サイトのシステムなどが不正アクセスを受け、名前や住所、電話番号などの個人情報、およそ438万人分が漏えいしたと明らかにしました。今のところ漏えいした情報の不正利用は確認されていないとしています。

japan1.title: 北陸新幹線延伸 京都府・市からは懸念など相次ぐ
japan1.description: 北陸新幹線の新大阪までの延伸ルートを議論する与党の委員会が開かれ、出席した京都府知事と京都市長からは地元の理解や財政負担に関する懸念が表明されました。

japan1.title: 西武池袋本店が入る建物を一部改装 家電量販大手が新店舗
japan1.description: 東京 池袋にある「西武池袋本店」が入る建物の一部で改装を進めていた家電量販大手のヨドバシホールディングスは、新しい店舗をオープンさせました。地元からの懸念の声や工事の遅れなどもあって、土地や建物の取得から2年半以上たっての開業になります。

japan1.title: ペルシャ湾内の日本関係船舶 新たに3隻がホルムズ海峡通過
japan1.description: 金子国土交通大臣は、6月30日の閣議のあとの会見で、ペルシャ湾内にとどまっていた日本関係の船舶のうち新たに3隻がホルムズ海峡を通過したと明らかにしました。いずれも乗組員の健康状態に問題はなく、船体に異常はないということです。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 6月30日(火)】ペットの暑さ対策に商機
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 円相場 一時1ドル＝162円台に 約39年半ぶりの円安水準
japan1.description: 30日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は午前中に1ドル＝162円台をつけました。1986年12月以来、およそ39年半ぶりの円安水準となっています。

japan1.title: 6月 卵の平均価格 5か月連続で前年同月下回るも高止まり続く
japan1.description: 6月の卵の平均卸売価格は目安となる東京地区のMサイズで5か月連続で前の年の同じ月を下回りました。ただ、6月としては3番目に高い水準で価格の高止まりが続いています。

japan2.title: Number of hibakusha drops to 91,105
japan2.description: The average age of hibakusha rose from 86.13 to 86.66.

japan2.title: ‘My dream is broken’: Japan visa rules push out foreign residents
japan2.description: "I always wanted to become a bridge between Japan and Nepal ... but my dream is broken," Budhathoki Samjhana said.

japan2.title: Japan’s FX chief flags contact with U.S., intervention impact
japan2.description: Mimura's remarks indicate that he continues to see intervention as a useful tool to stem excessive moves in the currency market.

japan2.title: Traditional Japanese mechanical dolls showcased in London
japan2.description: Karakuri ningyo, or wooden automata powered without electricity, became popular in Japan during the Edo Period

japan2.title: NATO allies have grown silent on rights concerns in Turkey

bd3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bd3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bd3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bd3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bd3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bd3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
